description: Paths the benchmark harness must never treat as a writable game shadow. Active installations, shared game images, the shared harness/evidence stores and any checkout of this repository are protected: game_shadow.py refuses a shadow root or -Game path under one of these prefixes, and path_guard.py denies automated writes to them. The private classroom shadows (D:\Temp\Deracine\CUSA11919-guardrails-*) are deliberately NOT listed; they are the copy the benchmark owns.
notes: Entries are literal prefixes after realpath (junctions, symlinks and reparse points resolved), so a name-squatting sibling such as CUSA11919-quality is refused as well.
%REPO% expands to this checkout (the worktree this file runs from); %WORKSPACE% expands to its parent, M:\Development\Deracine-work, where the shared _build harness and lab live.
CUSA11919-qual is the shared read-only content source that the private shadow junctions into. Selecting it as -Game would write engine.ini into the shared image, so it is blocked.
CUSA11919-1.01 and CUSA11919-color are additional shared game images already listed as protected in preflight.ps1's deny roots.
The recovery evidence store is a protected path from the autonomous-engineering contract; no benchmark shadow may live inside it.
